scope: One music-driven orb and wave field; direct entry; no room or world expansion

entry.audio_start: decoded sample zero after one user gesture and readiness

orbs.opening: white rounded centres with small soft halos
orbs.emitter_type: larger orb within the same field
orbs.beat_response: visible local pulse followed by expanding raised front
orbs.density_status: Retune for low view; no approved count or screenshot implied
orbs.world_origins: deterministic absolute coordinates; stable on recycling/replay

wave_system.events: reviewed kicks or explicitly unreviewed candidates; sparse softer intro accents
wave_system.reconstruction: sample only events in the lifetime window at current song position

camera.frame_target: nearby crests approach at eye/horizon level
camera.clearance: sample rendered height including events; anticipate crests; retain positive clearance without aerial framing

held_palette_contract: Palette and base coverage remain steady; terrain, fronts and beat illumination continue.
colour_bleed: Smooth spatial overlap on fronts/patches; fade towards white outside held sections.
reduced_motion: less or no automatic travel; less height; softer pulse; same musical and colour timing
clock: existing audio presentation position, never accumulated wall/frame time
rendering: linear working space; one output conversion; antialiased size-aware cores; bounded selective bloom; unresolved-distance fade
scope_status: Inherited proposal for the approved wave core; old cursor/sky/mode exclusions superseded by current arrangement.as-built.json and AGENTS.md.
